definitions.explanation: The third month of the year. In Japan, this is graduation season and the end of the fiscal/school year.

examples.japanese: {三月|さんがつ}に{卒業|そつぎょう}します。
{三月|さんがつ}は{暖|あたた}かくなります。
{三月|さんがつ}から{桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}きます。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms start blooming from March.

notes: March is literally 'month three.' In Japan, the school year and fiscal year end in March, making it a season of graduations and farewells. The cherry blossom (桜) season typically begins in late March in much of Japan.
